title: Callback secret is empty for the job
root_cause: The script requires a nonempty CALAMINT_CALLBACK, but the workflow-provided secret is empty in this run. Kotlin's require check throws before the callback can be used.

relevant_evidence.why: The job shows an empty callback environment value.
The script reports the empty callback and exits.
The script rejects an empty or absent value.
The value is supplied from a workflow secret.
